title: Flow Selection Bounds Align
description: Add bounding rectangle to flow display with alignment buttons on top (left align, vertical equal spacing, right align) and right side (top align, horizontal equal spacing, bottom align).
summary: Fixed non-responsive align buttons: controls were positioned outside the selection rect (negative translate) and were clipped by overflow-hidden playground panes, so clicks never reached them. Moved toolbars inside the bounding rect, added container pointerdown-capture hit testing as fallback, and verified FlowSession.alignSelection wasm path with integration test.
